scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cutpoint/core build && pnpm --filter @cutpoint/services build && pnpm --filter @cutpoint/adapters build && pnpm --filter @cutpoint/api-server build
scripts.codegen:core: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --layers core --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:identity: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:webapp: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --domain markets --domain labelling --domain discovery --domain interventions --domain governance --layers webapp --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build --no-fail-fast --no-clean
